name: MBBS
full: Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery
summary: A competency-based curriculum integrating early clinical exposure, simulation training and community-oriented learning.
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English; qualifying NEET-UG score as per national norms.

name: BDS
summary: Training in oral health sciences with pre-clinical simulation labs and structured clinical rotations.
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English; NEET-UG qualified.

name: B.Sc. Nursing
summary: Evidence-based nursing education with skills-lab practice and community health postings.
eligibility: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English with minimum 45% aggregate.

name: B.Sc. Allied Health Sciences
full: Medical Laboratory, Radiology & Imaging, Anaesthesia Technology
summary: Career-oriented programmes producing skilled health technologists.

name: MD / MS
full: Doctor of Medicine / Master of Surgery
summary: Specialty training across pre-, para- and clinical disciplines with a thesis and research methodology training.
eligibility: MBBS with NMC registration; NEET-PG qualified.

name: M.Sc. Medical Sciences
summary: Research-oriented postgraduate training in basic medical sciences.
eligibility: B.Sc. in a relevant life-science discipline or MBBS/BDS.

name: M.Sc. Nursing
summary: Advanced practice, education and leadership in nursing.
eligibility: B.Sc. Nursing with at least one year of experience.

name: Ph.D. (Medical Sciences)
summary: Doctoral research with supervised coursework, publications and institutional ethics oversight.
eligibility: Postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline; University entrance test and interview.
